messages:
Aria: quick ops thread — finalizing reg page + zoom config for next Tue webinar. need owners for reg copy, consent text, backup recording, and post-event CTA gating. who can take what?
Ben: I can own Zoom + backup. plan: cloud recording -> aws bucket, plus local host backup. will test RTMP fallback.
Chen: I'll do HubSpot field mapping and the nurture flows. also need GDPR checkbox wording for EU regs.
Priya: Ill handle launch posts + the short-form cutdown script for socials. want to prepare 3 assets: announcement, reminder, replay clip.
Aria: thanks. Legal, can we have a single consent string that works for US/EU?
LegalBot: propose two lines: (1) "I agree to receive follow-up emails and marketing about this event." (2) For EU: "I consent to marketing communications and understand my data will be processed as described in the Privacy Policy." both must be opt-in, not prechecked.
Ben: Zoom settings (to be set on meeting config):
```
Auto-recording: Cloud (record active speaker + shared screen)
Closed captions: On (enable transcript & SRT export)
Co-hosts: ben@redwood.com, priya@redwood.com\Waiting room: Off\Participant screen sharing: Host only\```
Ben: Backup plan: local recording on host + OBS RTMP-> s3://redwood-webinars/backup/YYYYMMDD_event.mp4. I will run a 10-min RTMP test during greenroom.
Chen: HubSpot mapping (fields):
- email -> contact.email
- first_name,last_name -> contact.firstname,contact.lastname
- company -> company
- role -> persona
- timezone -> timezone
- consent_eu -> marketing_consent_eu
- utm_source/medium/campaign -> utm_source/utm_medium/utm_campaign
Chen: Routing rules:
- Attended + poll/click -> create task -> SDR queue regionally mapped
- Attended (>50% watch) -> tag: webinar:attended_high_priority
- Registered no-show -> nurture list (3-email drip)
Priya: Clip plan: 1) 15s teaser for LinkedIn/Twitter; 2) 60s highlight for Instagram/YT shorts; 3) 90s product demo slice. Deliver within 48h.
Aria: replay page: gated PDF and button to "Request a Live Demo". gating rules: clicking request creates a meeting lead in HubSpot and flags SDR. Priya, can you add short demo CTA overlay on clips?
Priya: yes. small overlay CTAs on clips that link to meeting link.
Ben: runbook snippet for greenroom and fallback: 
```
Greenroom (30m prior):
- Confirm co-hosts signed in
- Start cloud recording once host joins
- Start local recording (host)
- Start OBS RTMP to backup bucket
- Run 10s caption sync test: speak "caption sync test" and confirm SRT timestamps
If cloud recording fails:
- Stop OBS and save local recording, upload to s3/backup, notify marketing slack channel
- If SRT missing -> trigger speech-to-text pipeline (model: whisper-medium) and attach timestamps
```
Chen: GDPR note: store consent value in contact property 'marketing_consent_eu' with timestamp. Do not send marketing emails if declined.
LegalBot: Also ensure privacy link on reg page and replay page. short copy: "Event recorded; highlights may be used for marketing. See Privacy Policy."
Priya: social copy draft (announcement): "Join our hands-on session on inference ops — we'll demo latency tweaks and cost wins. RSVP now -> [link]." will drop 2 variants: product-led and platform-led headline.
Aria: benchmarking ask: include optional checkbox "Id like to opt into the micro-benchmark pilot" that adds them to a separate list for follow-up. Chen, make sure this is separate property so we can score post-event.
Chen: added field: benchmark_opt_in -> boolean. If true and attendee accepted, add to QA cohort and send short feedback form in replay email.
Ben: ZoomBot: will post recording link when available. please wait for processing before clipping.
ZoomBot: Recording uploaded: https://zoom.us/recording/def987654 (status: processing)
Priya: post-event timeline:
- +2h: raw recording & SRT uploaded to marketing asset bucket
- +6h: clips first draft to reviewers
- +24h: publish first clip + replay page live
- +72h: publish remaining clips and follow-up nurture emails
Aria: lead scoring rules for SDR handoff:
- Score +50: attended & demo request OR attended & benchmark_opt_in
- Score +30: attended & interacted (poll/chat/click)
- Score +10: watched > 50% but no interaction
Chen: automation: map score->deal_stage recommendations and create tasks for scores >=50. I'll create the workflow in staging and share screenshots.
LegalBot: confirm consent copy submitted to Legal channel for final sign-off.
Aria: anyone volunteering to own replay landing page and PDF gating?
Priya: I'll mock the PDF and page copy; Aria can review and publish.
Ben: I'll add the backup bucket path to the runbook and test the RTMP flow tomorrow 10am PT.
Aria: perfect. final checklist before greenroom: reg page copy + consent (Chen), HubSpot mapping (Chen), Zoom config + backup (Ben), social post copy (Priya), legal signoff (LegalBot). Greenroom scheduled 30m before show. thanks all :rocket:
